purpose: Teach: ソヴィエト/マオリ/秦/劉/宋/萬/鵐/カキ

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧ソヴィエト圏の医療制度史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren, we're going to study the history of healthcare systems in the former Soviet sphere as a medical team.
lines.style: Direct, professional address. Clear enunciation on Ren's name. Steady, measured pacing. Even-keeled delivery—this is information being shared, not debated. Composed clinical tone throughout.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、マオリ族の伝統医療を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're going to research traditional Māori healing practices together as a medical team.
lines.style: Same professional composure. Slight emphasis on 'traditional'—acknowledging the cultural weight. Unhurried. Clinical but not cold. Even delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、漢方の起源、秦の処方を医療チームで紐解きます
lines.en: Ren, we'll be exploring the origins of Chinese herbal medicine—the Qin dynasty formulations—as part of our medical team's research.
lines.style: Steady, educational tone. Light stress on 'origins' to mark the historical significance. Clear pacing. Composed. Factual presentation without rush.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、劉氏漢代の医書を医療チームで参考にします
lines.en: Ren, we'll be consulting the Han dynasty medical texts attributed to Liu as references for our medical team.
lines.style: Measured delivery. Precise on the historical attribution. Even pacing. Professional courtesy—naming the source clearly. Calm, academic tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、宋朝の鍼灸医学を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, we're going to research Song dynasty acupuncture and moxibustion medicine with our medical team.
lines.style: Consistent professional composure. Even emphasis. Clear, unhurried pacing. Steady tone—the work is organized and moving forward methodically.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医薬萬古、つまり「萬」の入った古い薬名を医療チームで整理します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be cataloguing the old pharmaceutical names—those containing the character meaning 'ten thousand'—as our medical team organizes them.
lines.style: Slightly slower on the explanation of the character's meaning. Patient. Professional. Even rhythm. Composed and clear—making sure the detail lands without condescension.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、鵐、つまり野鳥由来の感染症リスクを医療チームで監視します
lines.en: Ren, we need to monitor the risk of zoonotic infections from wild birds within our medical team's surveillance.
lines.style: Slight increase in attentiveness. Still composed. Clear, measured pacing. Professional gravity—this is risk assessment. Steady voice, no alarm, just awareness.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、牡蠣、つまりカキ食中毒の発症事例を医療チームで対応します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be managing case responses for shellfish food poisoning incidents as our medical team coordinates the response.
lines.style: Steady, professional. Slight closing warmth—teamwork acknowledged. Unhurried pacing. Composed. Clinical but collaborative tone. Small ease at the end.
